column1: # PEANUTS: experimental Android profile for the base game. Recap and early field control seen on an AYN Thor and an AYN Odin 2 (Turnip); later gameplay and water unverified.

column4: Tessellation shaders: the base water materials use five hull and five domain shaders; water rendering is unverified and patch draws are not implemented
Shader draw parameters: all 885 vertex shaders of the game declare DrawParameters
Storage image writes without a format: ten of the game's shaders use them
64-bit integers in shaders: one of the game's shaders uses them
Buffer device addresses: one of the game's shaders declares physical storage buffer addresses
